intro: Grenada earns money from tourism, spices and a medical school.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Grenada is one of the world's top nutmeg producers, and nutmeg is on its flag. St George's University, a large medical school, brings many students.

chapters.title: Chocolate
text: Grenada makes chocolate from its own organic cocoa.

keyTerms.meaning: A spice from the nutmeg's red covering.

cardGroups.title: Made in Grenada
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Grenada makes and sells to the world.
